claude_proposed_widenings.name: revert_transformation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a failed Con save, a shape-shifted creature (e.g. under Polymorph) reverts to its true form. No existing atom models forced reversion of a transformation effect. The closest candidates — end_ongoing_spells (too broad: ends all spells) and transform_target (applies a polymorph outward, not inward) — do not honestly represent 'undo the current transformation on this target'. Needed as a first-class effect atom targeting the creature's active transformation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, a creature takes 2d10 Radiant damage, and if the creature is shape-shifted (as a result of the Polymorph spell, for example), it reverts to its true form and can't shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_shapeshifting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: After reverting, the creature cannot shape-shift again until it exits the cylinder. This is a persistent area-scoped suppressor on the shapeshifting action — distinct from any existing condition (none of the 15 SRD conditions match) and distinct from apply_condition or block_targeting. It is conditional on the creature remaining inside the area attachment.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: …it reverts to its true form and can't shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.usageLimit: once_per_turn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Moonbeam (and Cloudkill, Spirit Guardians) fire the save at most once per turn per creature even if multiple triggers (enter + end-of-turn) would both apply on the same turn. There is no rate-limiting field on OngoingOperation. The existing UsageLimit type (once_per_turn) lives on mastery mechanics and ActivatedAbilityMechanics but not on OngoingOperation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes this save only once per turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger: on_area_repositioned_onto_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The save fires when the spell's area moves into a creature's space (not when the creature moves into the area). The existing on_creature_enters_area covers voluntary creature movement; there is no trigger for the symmetric case where the area moves to envelop a stationary creature. The reposition_attachment effect atom exists but no associated trigger fires for creatures newly engulfed by the repositioned area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature also makes this save when the spell's area moves into its space…
